fusions.name: Three Stings
fusions.desc: Darts all three tines out as stings, each dealing 3 poison damage to the first enemy it meets within 4 tiles. Each hit has a 20% chance to leave the target [Poisoned] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Barb Left Behind
fusions.desc: Drives a barbed tine into the first enemy within 5 tiles for 16 piercing damage, using up every one of your afflictions on it and dealing 50% more for each.

fusions.name: Hive Tempo
fusions.desc: Increases your attack speed by 25% for 12 seconds. For the first 8 seconds a swarm fights beside you, striking for 3 every 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: Pooled Venom
fusions.desc: Every hit you land builds a stack of venom on that enemy, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: a blow strikes that enemy for 34% of your weapon damage per stack (170% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
